segs.t: We use a few essential cookies to run the site, and analytics and advertising cookies only if you say yes. This policy is part of our Privacy Policy.

A cookie is a small text file a website stores in your browser. Pixels (also called tags) are small pieces of code that work with cookies to record actions, such as a completed purchase. "First-party" cookies are set by us; "third-party" cookies are set by other companies.

segs.t: collects the pages you visit (with result and order numbers hidden), where you came from (UTM tags and the previous site), steps such as starting the test, seeing free results, opening checkout and completing payment with the amount and order number, your device and browser, and your approximate location (country and city). The data goes to Google LLC in the United States and is kept for the retention period we set in Google Analytics. We do not use ad personalization or Google signals. You can also block it with Google's opt-out tool (tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout).

uses the X pixel (pages visited, cookie, device and browser information) and, when you complete a payment, the X Conversions API (order number, amount, and the ad click ID or your IP address and browser information). The data goes to X Corp. in the United States and is kept under X's privacy policy. You can also turn off personalized ads in your X account under Privacy and safety → Ad preferences.
We never send your birth details, nickname, answers, email address or phone number to Google or X. Refusing analytics or advertising cookies does not affect how you use the Service.
Optional cookies stay off until you allow them. You can allow analytics and ad-measurement cookies with the optional checkbox when you start the test, and change your mind any time under

You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, sign-in and payment will not work. To limit personalized ads more widely, see your X ad settings, www.youronlinechoices.eu (EU) or optout.aboutads.info (US).
California residents: turning off advertising cookies is how you opt out of "sharing" under California law. We also honor Global Privacy Control signals.
